record.question: Diet recommended for a patient with glomerulonephritis:
options: Low protein, high sodium and potassium
record.explanation: Answer B: Low protein, high calorie. Glomerulonephritis diets depend on renal function, edema, and electrolytes; limiting protein may reduce nitrogenous waste while adequate calories prevent catabolism. Among the choices, low protein/high calorie is the best fit. Source/context note: Dietary protein and sodium/potassium restrictions must be individualized; avoid a universal prescription. Reference: https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/kidney-disease/glomerular-diseases. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
